title: Project Manager Production Ramp-up (m/f/d)
description:
We are looking for a Project Manager to ramp up new production lines for electric drive components.

What you'll do
- Manage ramp-up projects from tooling release to start of production
- Coordinate suppliers, plant engineering and quality
- Track budget and milestones; escalate risks early

What you bring
- Engineering degree and 5+ years in production or project management
- Experience with change management and SAP
- Fluent business English, as you will report to our site in the US
